Match the original seaborn box saturation. rgb = np.array(plt.matplotlib.colors.to_rgb(color)) import colorsys h, l, s = colorsys.rgb_to_hls(*rgb) box.set_facecolor(colorsys.hls_to_rgb(h, l, s * 0.75)) for x, stat in enumerate(stats): values = sorted(set([stat['whislo'], stat['med'], stat['whishi']])) ax.scatter([x] * len(values), values, color='black', s=16, alpha=0.6, zorder=3) box_results.append(result) plt.title(title, fontsize=12, pad=12) plt.xlabel('Region', fontsize=10) plt.ylabel(prefix, fontsize=10) plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right') plt.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3) plt.tight_layout() plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight') ''' Path("chart.py").write_text(source) plt.close('all') exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"), globals() | {"__file__": str(Path("chart.py").resolve())}) print("Saved corrected output.png") continue
